key.decision_why: The author answered the commit-message feedback with a force push but no code or approach change, so a short note under the existing card is enough and nobody is actively reviewing the PR yet.
key.action_why: Maintainers did nothing for 14 days, and the rewritten commit summary "drafts: Preserve focus on draft action controls." still ends with a period, which Zulip commit style forbids, so a careful triager would keep "not ready" and point that out instead of handing off.
changed: The author force-pushed once and rewrote the commit summary from "drafts: Enable keyboard navigation for draft action buttons" to "drafts: Preserve focus on draft action controls.".
The code is the same as before: +26/-6 in the same 3 files.
still_missing: The commit summary line still ends with a period, which does not match Zulip commit style.
The issue is written as "Fixes: issue-#39005", which GitHub does not link, so the PR is not linked to #39005 (it should say "Fixes #39005", ideally in the commit message).
key.reply_ask: Ask the author to remove the trailing period from the commit summary line and to reference the issue as "Fixes #39005" so it links, then ask for another look.

must_have.fact: Says the new commit summary "drafts: Preserve focus on draft action controls." still ends with a period, so the commit message still does not match Zulip style.
Recommends keeping "not ready" and giving more feedback rather than handing the PR to a reviewer.
Says the push changed only the commit message, with no code changes (still +26/-6 in the same 3 files).

Flags the overlapping open PR #39959 (keyboard navigation for row action buttons in message overlays), which works in the same area.
